column1: # Binaries installed into the image straight from GitHub releases.
# Always tracks the latest release: the URL form used is
# which GitHub redirects to the current release, so no API call, no token and
# no version pinning. The image rebuilds nightly, so new upstream releases land
#   asset     release asset filename. A .tar.gz is extracted; anything else is
#   binaries  space-separated names to install into /usr/bin. For a bare-binary
#             asset this is the name it gets installed as.
#   checksum  "sha256sum" -> fetch <asset>.sha256sum and verify the extracted
#             binary against it. "none" -> upstream publishes no checksum.
# Man pages (*.1) found in an extracted archive are installed automatically.
